mapper.select: SELECT SYSTEM_SETTING_SN, SERVICE_NM, CS_CENTER_TELNO, OPRT_EML_ADDR, FAX_NO, AUTO_LOGOUT_MIN, PSWD_CHG_CYCLE_CD, MDFCN_DT FROM SYSTEM_SETTING WHERE SYSTEM_SETTING_SN = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE SYSTEM_SETTING SET SERVICE_NM = #{serviceNm}, CS_CENTER_TELNO = #{csCenterTelno}, OPRT_EML_ADDR = #{oprtEmlAddr}, FAX_NO = #{faxNo}, AUTO_LOGOUT_MIN = #{autoLogoutMin}, PSWD_CHG_CYCLE_CD = #{pswdChgCycleCd}, MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE SYSTEM_SETTING_SN = 1
mapper.select: SELECT SYSTEM_INTEGRATION_SN, INTEGRATION_CD, INTEGRATION_NM, CONN_STTS_CD, SORT_ORDER FROM SYSTEM_INTEGRATION ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, SYSTEM_INTEGRATION_SN ASC
